$comment: Which action call a caret stands in, in a Datastar expression (actionCallAt): the caret is at the end of before, and only the text before it is read. action is the innermost @name( still open around the caret, or null; argument counts from 0. option is set when the caret is where a key of a backend action's options object goes: typed is what is written of the key so far, written the keys already in the object. Read by CompletionContextsTest.kt.

an object inside an option is not the options object
